mods.name: Continuum Core
mods.description: Shared library code for the NeoForge 26.1 Continuum Construct port.

releases.notes:
Continuum Core 26.1.2-1.11.5.1

Fixes
- Fixed a recipe sync crash that could disconnect or crash clients when a datapack or third-party mod produced an empty fluid output during NeoForge recipe payload syncing.
- Empty fluid recipe outputs are now tolerated during network sync, while normal recipe/datagen validation remains strict.

Notes
- This targets the reported `FluidStack cannot be empty` / `neoforge:recipe_content` crash path.
- Tested by building the Core jar and loading a large modpack-style client until world load; the original fluid packet crash did not reproduce.

releases.notes:
Continuum Core 26.1.2-1.11.5

Fixes
- Fixed recipe item outputs that were created during early datapack loading keeping temporary direct item holders at runtime.
- Fixed cleaver/severing drops causing massive NBT predicate log spam after dropped items were picked up or scanned.
- Renamed the fork branding from Continuum Mantle to Continuum Core while preserving upstream credits and the technical `mantle` mod id for compatibility.
- Fixed Mantle loadable recipes losing their recipe ID during NeoForge codec loading.
- Added a fallback recipe ID context for JSON recipe decode, improving compatibility with mods that generate Tinkers/Continuum integration recipes such as Productive Bees.
- Fixed recipe sync disconnects caused by empty item outputs in NeoForge recipe payloads.
- Fixed recipe sync disconnects when complex ingredients were decoded from network packets.
- Fixed enchantment predicate syncing for translated enchantment names that no longer carry a bound registry holder.
- Improved client safety around early keybind checks during modded UI setup.

releases.notes:
Continuum Mantle 26.1.2-1.11.1

Port
- Ported Mantle to Minecraft 26.1.2 and NeoForge 26.1.
- Updated the build to use NeoForge ModDev, Java 25 toolchains, and current dependency coordinates.
- Migrated resource metadata from Forge mods.toml to NeoForge neoforge.mods.toml.

Compatibility
- Updated recipe, ingredient, fluid, loot, network, model, book, command, and registry helpers for the 26.1 API surface.
- Updated generated fluid transfer data and tag paths to the current singular tag folder layout.
- Restored client-side model helpers for retextured blocks, retextured items, connected models, item layers, and book structure previews.

Fixes
- Improved recipe sync failures so loadable recipe packet errors include the failing recipe ID.
- Updated fluid tooltip and transfer handling for current item, potion, and fluid APIs.
- Updated Mantle networking helpers and packets for NeoForge custom payload handling.

Version Safety
- Restricted supported Minecraft versions to [26.1.2,26.2).
- Restricted supported NeoForge versions to [26.1.2.78,26.2), so older or newer incompatible loaders fail with a clear dependency message.
